components.name: Stack
components.signature: Stack(children: [Component], direction?: column|row, gap?: sm|md|lg)
components.description: Lays its children out in a column or a row.

components.name: Card
components.signature: Card(children: [Component], title?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A bordered block with an optional title.

components.name: Section
components.signature: Section(title: text, children: [Component], open?: true|false, collapsible?: true|false)
components.description: A titled part of the answer, collapsible when it is long.

components.name: Separator
components.signature: Separator()
components.description: A thin rule.

components.name: Heading
components.signature: Heading(text: text, level?: number, tone?: tone)
components.description: A heading inside a block.

components.name: Markdown
components.signature: Markdown(text: text)
components.description: A paragraph of plain text.

components.name: Callout
components.signature: Callout(tone: tone, title: text, body?: text)
components.description: A highlighted note: info, success, warning or danger.

components.name: Badge
components.signature: Badge(text: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A short status label.

components.name: Quote
components.signature: Quote(text: text, source?: text)
components.description: A quotation with its source.

components.name: Table
components.signature: Table(columns: [Col|ColGroup], rows: [[cell]|Row], caption?: text, sortable?: true|false, striped?: true|false, compact?: true|false)
components.description: Rows and columns. A cell is a text, a number, a Badge, an Item or a Cell; a row is a list of cells or a Row. Columns may be grouped under a heading with ColGroup.

components.name: Col
components.signature: Col(label: text, kind?: text|number|percent|money|date, align?: left|right|center, tone?: tone)
components.description: A column of Table: its label, how its values are formatted, and a tone that tints the whole column.

components.name: ColGroup
components.signature: ColGroup(label: text, columns: [Col], tone?: tone)
components.description: A heading over several Cols of a Table.

components.name: Row
components.signature: Row(cells: [text|number|Badge|Item|Cell], tone?: tone, kind?: normal|section|total|header)
components.description: A row of a Table that is more than a list of cells: kind section is a title across the whole table, total is a bold closing row, header repeats the column heads.

components.name: Cell
components.signature: Cell(content: text|number|Badge|Item|Cell, tone?: tone, bold?: true|false, colspan?: number, rowspan?: number, align?: left|right|center)
components.description: One cell of a Table with its own colour, weight, alignment or size: colspan merges cells to the right, rowspan merges the cells below (leave them out of the next rows).

components.name: Metric
components.signature: Metric(label: text, value: text|number, delta?: text|number, trend?: up|down|flat, note?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: One figure with its label and its change.

components.name: MetricRow
components.signature: MetricRow(metrics: [Metric])
components.description: Several Metric side by side.

components.name: BarChart
components.signature: BarChart(labels: [text], series: [Series], mode?: grouped|stacked, unit?: text, horizontal?: true|false, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: Bars, one group per label and one bar per series.

components.name: LineChart
components.signature: LineChart(labels: [text], series: [Series], unit?: text, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: Lines over ordered labels: a trend, a learning curve (loss and accuracy per epoch).

components.name: AreaChart
components.signature: AreaChart(labels: [text], series: [Series], unit?: text, stacked?: true|false, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: Filled lines over ordered labels.

components.name: PieChart
components.signature: PieChart(labels: [text], values: [number], donut?: true|false, title?: text)
components.description: Shares of a whole.

components.name: ScatterChart
components.signature: ScatterChart(series: [Points], xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text, title?: text)
components.description: Points on two axes, one colour per Points.

components.name: Series
components.signature: Series(name: text, values: [number], tone?: tone)
components.description: A named list of values, one per label.

components.name: Points
components.signature: Points(name: text, points: [[number]], tone?: tone, line?: true|false)
components.description: A named list of [x, y] points, for ScatterChart or a Plot; line joins them in order (a path, an ROC curve).

components.name: Plot
components.signature: Plot(layers: [Curve|Shade|Dot|VLine|HLine|Points], xmin: number, xmax: number, ymin?: number, ymax?: number, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: A graph of formulas in x over [xmin, xmax], with the layers drawn on the same axes. The vertical range is automatic unless given.

components.name: Curve
components.signature: Curve(expr: text, label?: text, tone?: tone, dashed?: true|false, op?: value|derivative|integral)
components.description: A formula in x (x^3 - 3x + 1, sin(2x)/x, e^(-x^2); + - * / ^, sin cos tan exp ln sqrt abs, pi, e). op derivative draws its derivative and integral its antiderivative from xmin, both computed numerically.

components.name: Shade
components.signature: Shade(expr: text, from: number, to: number, label?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: The area between a formula and the x axis from one bound to another; the legend gives its value (the definite integral).

components.name: Dot
components.signature: Dot(x: number, y: number, label?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A marked point of a Plot (a root, an extremum, an inflection point), with its label.

components.name: VLine
components.signature: VLine(x: number, label?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A vertical guide of a Plot at x (an asymptote, a bound).

components.name: HLine
components.signature: HLine(y: number, label?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A horizontal guide of a Plot at y (an asymptote, a threshold, a mean).

components.name: Histogram
components.signature: Histogram(values: [number], bins?: number, title?: text, xLabel?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: The distribution of a list of values, in equal bins (a residual, a feature, a weight).

components.name: Heatmap
components.signature: Heatmap(rows: [text], cols: [text], values: [[number]], title?: text, tone?: tone, decimals?: number)
components.description: A grid of numbers shaded by value: a confusion matrix, a correlation matrix, an attention map.

components.name: Architecture
components.signature: Architecture(children: [Component], flows?: [Flow], title?: text)
components.description: The frame of a system drawing: it lays Panels out and draws the Flow arrows over them.

components.name: Panel
components.signature: Panel(children: [Component], title?: text, tone?: tone, icon?: icon, dashed?: true|false, direction?: column|row)
components.description: A coloured box with a title and an icon that holds Items or other Panels, in a column or in a wrapping row. Give it its own name to link it with a Flow.

components.name: Item
components.signature: Item(label: text, icon?: icon, caption?: text, boxed?: true|false, tone?: tone)
components.description: A line with an icon, a label and a caption; boxed draws it as a card. Give it its own name to link it with a Flow.

components.name: Flow
components.signature: Flow(from: name, to: name, label?: text, both?: true|false, style?: solid|dashed)
components.description: An arrow between two Panels or Items, by the names of their statements. Only inside the flows of an Architecture.

components.name: Steps
components.signature: Steps(items: [Step])
components.description: An ordered procedure.

components.name: Step
components.signature: Step(title: text, body?: text, status?: todo|doing|done|blocked)
components.description: One step of Steps.

examples:
root = Stack([title, kpis, table, note])
title = Heading("Terminal agents compared", 2)
kpis = MetricRow([m1, m2])
m1 = Metric("Tools compared", 5)
m2 = Metric("With a native sandbox", 3, "+1", "up")
table = Table([Col("Tool"), Col("Sandbox"), Col("Memory")], rows)
rows = [["Claude Code", Badge("yes", "success"), "CLAUDE.md"], ["Aider", Badge("no", "danger"), "chat history"]]
note = Callout("warning", "Not documented", "OpenCode does not document its internal database schema.")

root = Steps([s1, s2, s3])
s1 = Step("Install the runtime", "Run the installer, then restart the terminal.", "done")
s2 = Step("Add a provider key", "Open Settings, then Providers.", "doing")
s3 = Step("Send a first message")

root = Card([summary, plan], "Migration status", "info")
summary = MetricRow([Metric("Tables moved", 14, "+3", "up", "this week"), Metric("Left", 6)])
plan = Section("Next", [Steps([Step("Move the audit tables", null, "doing"), Step("Switch the reads", null, "todo")])])

root = Architecture([clients, runtime, storage], [f1, f2, f3], "Local app")
clients = Panel([ui, docs], "Inputs", "violet", "monitor", false, "row")
ui = Item("Desktop UI", "monitor", "React", true)
docs = Item("Documents", "files", "PDF, DOCX", true)
runtime = Panel([api, jobs, agents], "Runtime", "orange", "si:go", false, "row")
api = Item("HTTP API", "api", "Commands, streaming", true)
jobs = Item("Jobs", "workflow", "Indexing", true)
agents = Item("Agents", "ai", "LLM, tools", true)
storage = Panel([sql, olap], "Storage", "blue", "database", true, "row")
sql = Item("SQLite", "si:sqlite", "Transactions", true)
olap = Item("DuckDB", "si:duckdb", "Analytics", true)
f1 = Flow("ui", "api", null, true)
f2 = Flow("docs", "jobs", "ingest")
f3 = Flow("api", "sql")

root = Table([Col("Tool"), install, writes], rows, "Three engines compared", false, true)
install = ColGroup("Install", [Col("Size (MB)", "number"), Col("Setup")])
writes = ColGroup("Writes", [Col("Concurrent"), Col("Mode")], "violet")
rows = [Row(["Embedded"], "blue", "section"), ["SQLite", 1, "None", Cell("one writer", "warning"), "WAL"], ["DuckDB", 30, "None", Cell("one writer", "warning"), "Columnar"], Row(["Server"], "blue", "section"), ["PostgreSQL", 300, "Installer", Cell("many writers", "success", true), "MVCC"], Row(["Smallest", "SQLite"], null, "total")]

root = Stack([intro, plot, curve])
intro = Heading("f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 1 and its derivative", 3)
plot = Plot([f, slope, extremum1, extremum2, axis], -3, 3, null, null, "f and f'", "x", "y")
f = Curve("x^3 - 3x + 1", "f(x)", "blue")
slope = Curve("3x^2 - 3", "f'(x)", "orange", true)
extremum1 = Dot(-1, 3, "local maximum (-1, 3)", "red")
extremum2 = Dot(1, -1, "local minimum (1, -1)", "red")
axis = HLine(0)
curve = Plot([Curve("x^3 - 3x + 1", "f(x)"), Shade("x^3 - 3x + 1", -2, 2, "area under f")], -3, 3, null, null, "Integral from -2 to 2")

root = Stack([loss, matrix, errors])
loss = LineChart(["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"], [Series("train", [0.92, 0.55, 0.38, 0.29, 0.24]), Series("validation", [0.95, 0.63, 0.47, 0.42, 0.41])], null, "Loss per epoch", "epoch", "loss")
matrix = Heatmap(["cat", "dog", "bird"], ["cat", "dog", "bird"], [[48, 2, 0], [5, 41, 4], [1, 3, 46]], "Confusion matrix", "blue", 0)
errors = Histogram([-0.4, -0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.3, 0.45, 0.9], 5, "Residuals", "error")
